entities.name: Yenna
entities.description: Female Elf noble and regent of Redtooth Keep, leader of the Redtooth elves; distrustful and proud.

entities.name: Armont
entities.description: Ardenvale knight captain who stumbled upon Redtooth Keep and broke the curse.

entities.name: Redtooth Keep
entities.description: Keep ruled by Yenna, home of the cursed Redtooth elves.

entities.name: Redtooth elves
entities.description: Elves led by Yenna, cursed to turn into werefoxes each night.

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: Knightly order whose captain Armont visited the Keep.

events.summary: Armont and her knights stumble upon Redtooth Keep and Yenna warms to her kindness.
events.quote: When the Ardenvale knight captain Armont and her knights stumbled upon the Keep, Yenna eventually warmed to her kindness.

events.summary: Yenna tells Armont of an enchanted rose that would break the curse.
events.quote: She told Armont of an enchanted rose guarded by an archon in a glade nearby that would break the spell.
Armont was able to break the curse.

relations.quote: Yenna is the leader of the Redtooth elves, who were cursed to turn into werefoxes each night
It is implied the two fell in love.
